From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Technical alignment request + timeboxed slots (ops playbook & integration)

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — great context on MedSync's streaming ingestion pattern and retention constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can make the follow-up technical session high signal: 

- Recap (from call):
  - Primary use case: near-real-time embeddings for search + redaction pipeline post-ingestion.
  - Data residency: customer records in GCP us-central, HIPAA controls required.
  - Throughput target: 200 qps peak with 90k tokens/session average.

- Goals for the technical alignment (30–40 min timebox):
  1) Walk through proposed ops playbook for inference (routing, batching, KV-caching).
  2) Integration options (hosted API vs dedicated vs private VPC).
  3) Security checklist and expected audit artifacts (SOC2 scope ask).
  4) Next engineering owners + mutual action items.

Can you confirm which of these three slots works for you (all times in PDT):
  • Tue May 16 — 10:00–10:40am
  • Tue May 16 — 3:00–3:40pm
  • Wed May 17 — 9:00–9:40am

I attached a one-page ops playbook draft for context and included a tentative agenda ICS (you should be able to add the invite once we pick a slot). When you confirm a slot I’ll send a Zoom link and include our solutions engineer Marissa and Karthik (integration lead). Please also confirm who from MedSync will attend (names + roles) so we pull the right docs.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MedSync-ops-playbook-draft.pdf, tech-alignment-agenda.ics
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsync.ai>

Date: 2028-05-12T17:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical alignment request + timeboxed slots (ops playbook & integration)

Rafael —

Appreciate the recap and clear goals. The team liked the proposed agenda. We can do Tue May 16 at 3:00pm PDT. I’ll be joined by Arjun Patel (CTO) and Lina Gomez (Lead Infra Engineer). Arjun will want the section on routing and fallbacks; Lina will want specifics on batch sizing, KV cache warmup, and the private deployment networking diagram.

Two quick asks before the session:
1) Can you include a short checklist of the observability outputs Redwood exposes (traces, token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms)?
2) If you have an integration checklist (what we need to open on our side for a POC: service account scopes, network ranges, expected traffic profiles), drop that before the meeting so Lina can prep.

I see your ICS attached — please send the Zoom link and I’ll accept.

Thanks,
Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of Partnerships, MedSync

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood-demo
Passcode: 4R3dW0od

Short pre-read links (we’ll bring more detail to the call):
- Observability snapshot: brief list of standard outputs (token cost breakdown, per-route p50/p95 latency, trace sampling hooks) — attached to this thread in the ops playbook.
- Integration checklist (high level): service account, IP allowlist, expected qps and token sizes, artifact exchange (certs/keys). I’ll paste a short checklist here later today and upload a one-page integration checklist to HubSpot for Lina.

I’ve attached the ICS to the thread (tech-alignment-agenda.ics) and pushed the meeting to your calendar on your accepted slot — let me know if Lina or Arjun prefer a different attendee email.

Marissa / Karthik — can you bring the short diagram for the private deployment (VPC peering flow + required firewall ports) and an example of KV cache hit-rate expectations for a 90k token session? Also assign any pre-read ownership (I’ll own the ops playbook PDF).

Rafael
